description: Keystone proactive multi-skill AI engineering workflows for planning, implementation, review, shipping, and maintenance.

defaultPrompt: Survey this repository and explain what is true before we decide what to change.
Reproduce this failing test and prove the root cause before proposing a fix.

interface.longDescription: Keystone helps developers move from ambiguity to verified delivery with 9 focused skills for understanding codebases, planning changes, implementing and refactoring safely, diagnosing failures, reviewing work, and shipping with evidence. Each skill keeps the current phase explicit, protects user-owned work, and requires proof before completion claims.
